Revenues

growth and the impacts of restructuring and other actions; partially offset by the revenue impacts of government programs, 
including the IRA-driven impacts on Medicare Part D plans; operating cost management; net portfolio divestitures in 2025 and 
decreased impacts related to the ENTITY_11 cyberattack.
